text:
The best night of the Panthers' month came in St. Louis, where the Blues honored Keith Tkachuk and his sons Matthew and Brady led Florida to a 4-1 win. Matthew called it "Icing On The Cake," per an NDTV Sports headline, and extended his assist streak to seven. Brady scored on the power play.

The bigger story is who isn't playing. Aleksander Barkov and Brad Marchand have both been out, and Yahoo Sports reported they could return within two weeks. That matters more than anything in the standings. Florida has been a 52% expected-goals team (the share of chance quality) without them, which is good, not dominant, and the record follows: 12-8-3, almost exactly the 26.4 points our numbers say they've earned.

The Tkachuks and Sam Bennett have carried the top line at 57% of the expected goals, though the goals have come in even at 10 for and 10 against. The power play generates 1.07 expected goals a game, but Florida also takes 5.2 penalties a night, as many as it draws. Tuesday's 5-2 loss to Edmonton was a reminder of the gap. Our numbers give them 59% playoff odds, which will look very different with Barkov back.
